_descripcion: Configuración Central de Producción, Consistencia Visual y Modo de Render (TikTok Radar)

opciones.hibrido: 8 Planos Cinemáticos Flow (Acción/Drama) + 5 Planos Infográficos FFmpeg Vector HUD (48 créditos/día para 6 vídeos)
opciones.flow_puro: 13 Planos 100% Cinemáticos en Google Flow (78 créditos/día para 6 vídeos)
opciones.demo: Renderizado NLE instantáneo de prueba sin invocar Google Flow (0 créditos)

consistencia_visual.estilo_maestro: Vertical 9:16, modern stylized 3D cinematic animation, Arcane and Spider-Verse tactical news thriller aesthetic, Unreal Engine 5 volumetric lighting, rich stylized textures, no photorealism, no uncanny valley
consistencia_visual.motor_render: Unreal Engine 5 Volumetric / Octane Render Style

G1_AVIACION.personaje: Stylized 3D male pilot with dark aviation headset, navy blue flight uniform, furrowed brow, focused expression, mouth closed
G1_AVIACION.aeronave: Sleek white twin-engine executive jet with deep navy rim accents and bright wingtip strobe lights
G1_AVIACION.cabina: Glass cockpit with dual glowing amber/cyan instrument panels, weather radar displays, and throttle quadrant

G1_PERU_DESASTRES.personaje: Stylized 3D emergency first responder in high-visibility orange-and-blue tactical jacket under heavy rain
G1_PERU_DESASTRES.entorno: Peruvian coastal and andean valley terrain, wet asphalt, emergency convoy flashing red and blue lights
G1_PERU_DESASTRES.sala_crisis: INDECI/COEN crisis monitoring room with massive glowing satellite weather displays and topography maps

G2_CIBERATAQUES.personaje: Stylized 3D cybersecurity intelligence analyst in dark tech facility illuminated by cyan and amber monitor glow
G2_CIBERATAQUES.entorno: High-density server vault with matte black racks, pulsing LED activity lights and fiber optic bundles
G2_CIBERATAQUES.elementos: Holographic command terminal displays showing encrypted traffic matrices and packet inspection nodes

G3_IA_HARDWARE.personaje: Stylized 3D cleanroom semiconductor engineer wearing white anti-static bunny suit and protective visor
G3_IA_HARDWARE.entorno: Extreme ultraviolet (High-NA EUV) lithography cleanroom with sterile golden and monochromatic lighting
G3_IA_HARDWARE.elementos: Translucent glowing 300mm silicon wafer with iridescent 2nm micro-architecture circuit patterns

G4_ESPACIO.personaje: Stylized 3D mission flight director in command center console wearing headset, tracking telemetry monitors
G4_ESPACIO.entorno: Deep space planetary orbit, atmospheric entry plasma trails, and robotic probe solar arrays
G4_ESPACIO.elementos: Precision navigation vector telemetry HUD, rocket thruster plume, and celestial horizon

reglas_infografias_ffmpeg.explicacion: Los gráficos FFmpeg Vector HUD SOLO se aplican a los planos de contexto, telemetría, esquemas técnicos, evidencias y debate (SH01, SH03, SH10, SH11, SH13). Los planos de acción humana, rostros y tensión SIEMPRE se generan en Flow como animación cinemática 3D.
